title: Dice Roll Simulation
summary: Given an array rollMax specifying the maximum consecutive rolls for each die face and an integer n for the total number of rolls, calculate the count of unique sequences possible with exactly n rolls.
statement: Given an array rollMax specifying the maximum consecutive rolls for each die face and an integer n for the total number of rolls, calculate the count of unique sequences possible with exactly n rolls. The result must be modulo 10^9 + 7. Sequences are distinct if at least one element differs.
constraints: Count length-n sequences of six die faces.
Face i may appear consecutively at most rollMax[i] times.
hints: Track the final face and its current run length.
Append each possible next face, resetting the run on a change and extending it on a repeat.
Keep only states within that face’s limit.
Face and run length contain all history relevant to the next legality decision.
editorial: Face and run length contain all history relevant to the next legality decision.

tests.explanation: Of thirty-six pairs, only repeated faces one and two are forbidden, leaving thirty-four.
Only pairs with different faces are legal, giving thirty.
